# How do I set up Foundry and deploy a contract to the Atlantic testnet?

Install [Foundry](https://book.getfoundry.sh/getting-started/installation), then use the Pharos token example:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/PharosNetwork/examples
cd examples/token/foundry/contract
forge install OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts --no-git
forge build
forge test
```

The example contract is `src/Token.sol`; its deployment script is `script/DeployToken.s.sol`. Set a testnet-funded deployer key, then broadcast the script to Atlantic:

```sh
export PRIVATE_KEY=<your-private-key>
forge script script/DeployToken.s.sol \
  --rpc-url https://atlantic.dplabs-internal.com \
  --broadcast
```

Atlantic’s chain ID is `688689`. The explorer is [atlantic.pharosscan.xyz](https://atlantic.pharosscan.xyz/). Make sure the deployer has enough testnet tokens for gas.

See [Write Your First Token](/developer-guide/foundry/write-your-first-token.md) for the contract and deployment script, and [Atlantic Testnet](/getting-started/network/atlantic-testnet.md) for network details.
